memo.objective: To assess whether purchasing followed the value bands in the Rules [rule:CPR-01], for the {{pack.risks_in_scope}} risks the auditor placed in scope.
memo.scope: The analysis covered {{$.population.rows_after_exclusions}} payments over {{$.population.months_covered}} months. Split-purchase windows in general procurement total {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold['25000.00'].headline_general_procurement.gbp}}.
memo.approach: Each flagged item is traced to the council's own records before any conclusion is drawn.
memo.limitations: Flags are indicators only; payments below the publication floor are not visible.

controls.control: Related purchases are aggregated before the value band is chosen.
Three quotes are sought at or above the publication value.

tests.step: For each sampled window, obtain the orders and quotation record and confirm how the value band was decided [rule:CPR-02] [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold['25000.00'].headline_general_procurement.windows].

controls.control: A register of contracts is kept.

tests.step: For each sampled group, obtain the invoices and confirm each payment was separately due [rule:CPR-04] [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.headline_general_procurement.groups].

pbc.request: Quotation records and purchase orders for the suppliers and dates in the sample.

rules_not_tested.reason: Single-quote purchases, Key Decisions and full tenders are outside the approved risks.
